Welcome
The adventure begins the moment you arrive at Rhulani Safari Lodge in the malaria-free Madikwe Game Reserve, where an African welcome awaits you. Rhulani means “relax”, and we invite you to sit back and enjoy the African bush with us!
Creating Rhulani has been both stimulating and inspirational. We set out to transform the ordinary into the extraordinary – to build a modern-day refuge, an oasis of calm, a place to nourish the soul and lift the spirit. We invite you to experience the serenity and harmony of this special place with us – come celebrate nature and life.
Luxury Accommodation
Indulge in the peace and tranquillity of the spectacular Madikwe Game Reserve. Enjoy the total privacy of your own plunge pool while you relax in the spacious luxury of your private chalet.
Choose between our six Luxury Private Chalets, the Luxury Private Chalet - Premium or the Luxury Family Suite.
Luxury Private Chalet
Luxury Private Chalet – Premium
Luxury Family Suite
Travelife Gold Accommodation Sustainability
In April 2025, Rhulani Safari Lodge became only the second hotel in South Africa to achieve Travelife Gold certification, independently recognising our commitment to responsible tourism, environmental sustainability, biodiversity, fair labour, human rights and animal welfare.
Travelife is a global accommodation sustainability certification body, respected for being impartial and robust. Its comprehensive criteria cover emissions, biodiversity, human rights, fair labour, child safeguarding and animal welfare.

pages.title: Rhulani Safari Lodge | Getting There
pages.text:
Rhulani Safari Lodge | Getting There
Skip to content
Useful tips for self-drivers from Johannesburg
Rhulani Safari Lodge is approximately 400 km from Johannesburg and can be reached by road in around 4½ to 5 hours, depending on traffic and road conditions.
GPS Location
Our GPS coordinates are:
S24° 46’ 58.44” / E26° 11’ 13.56”
Please travel to the Madikwe Game Reserve via main roads as described below and follow the signs to Rhulani within the reserve.
Google maps location:
Look for " Rhulani, South Africa " in Google maps
Driving from Johannesburg and OR Tambo International Airport to Rhulani
Download a printable version of the directions.
From Johannesburg (city): head north on the N1 (to Polokwane) towards the N4 / f rom Johannesburg (OR Tambo International Airport): exit the airport and take the R21 on the left to Pretoria, merge with N1 (to Polokwane) towards the N4 – distance: 58km
Take the N4 West (to Rustenburg) and pass Rustenburg and Swartruggens to Zeerust – distance 237km
In Zeerust, at the "STOP 3" sign turn right at President Street and merge immediately with the R49
Follow the R49 towards Gaborone; when arriving at Madikwe Game Reserve pass the first gate (Abjaterskop Gate) and turn right at the second gate (Wonderboom Gate), exactly 7km from the first gate – distance: 97km
Drive inside the reserve and follow the sign "Lodges" – distance 7km
Welcome to Rhulani Safari Lodge!
Total travelling time: approximately four-and-a-half to five hours
Driving from Rhulani to Johannesburg and OR Tambo International Airport
Exit Madikwe Reserve at Wonderboom Gate, turn left and drive to Zeerust.
In Zeerust turn left onto the N4 – keep driving on the N4 until you reach Rustenburg and then Pretoria (towards the N1).
Once in Pretoria, take the N1 South and then later take the R21 (to OR Tambo International Airport)
Travelling Tips
Keep to the speed limit, especially when it drops down from 120km/h to 80km/h or 60km/h. Traffic officials are often at these spots, including the small villages where the speed limit is 60km/h
Convenient bathroom and refreshment stops can be found at the Wimpy in Swartruggens or Zeerust.
If your vehicle takes unleaded fuel, fill up in Zeerust (it's approximately 100km from Zeerust to Madikwe Game Reserve) as the petrol stations between Zeerust and Madikwe are often out of unleaded fuel
Please make contact with our reception team on the day of your arrival, especially if you arrive after 2pm, so that we can organise activities and meals for you for the remainder of the
Should you have any trouble while on the road, please contact the lodge directly on +27 (0)82 907 9628 – our staff will do their best to assist you
Do you want to get a feeling of what the roads look like? Watch the second episode of Rhulani Insights video blog, in which owner Rolf Steiner is driving to Rhulani

pages.title: Rhulani Safari Lodge | Luxury Private Chalet
pages.text:
Rhulani Safari Lodge | Luxury Private Chalet
Skip to content
Luxury Family Suite
Make the gorgeous Madikwe Game Reserve your home away from home for your family by staying in our secluded Luxury Family Suite.
Our Luxury Family Suite is a spacious freestanding retreat with two bedrooms and a communal lounge.
En each separate separate bedroom choose between a king-sized bed or two single beds (all our beds have a mosquito curtain).
Each air-conditioned bedroom has en-suite bathroom (featuring an oval bath plus an indoor & outdoor shower) and comes equipped with a tea and coffee station (complete with a Nespresso machine), a fully stocked bar fridge, a safe, a hairdryer, and a Morso fireplace for those cosy winter evenings.
The suite also has a wireless internet connection, an international power plug and adaptors, a TV in the communal lounge and four deckchairs.
Enjoy family time in the communal lounge with its cozy sofa and a TV.
Delight in uninterrupted views of Madikwe Game Reserve from your private terrace, with its secluded heated plunge pool.
Maximum capacity : 4 adults in the two main bedrooms, 2 children under 16 years can be added and will sleep on a roll-away stretcher bed.
Room Size : 140 sqm, Terrace 120 sqm
